author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Employee Directory tab: added Home Address and a permanent Emergency Contact section, an editable HR Notes area (private, not shown to the employee), a new Salary History log (new workflow — record raises/adjustments with effective date, type, and reason; append-only, corrections are new entries not edits), and a Bonus History section pulling from existing Bonus Records. Bonus History matches employees to their bonus records via PTO Balance's user link, since Bonus Record is keyed by user account rather than directory record — shows 'no linked user account' for anyone without a PTO Balance set up yet.
